bio.title: Meet Jordan
paragraphs: Jordan is a product designer who enjoys simplifying dense workflows, organizing messy systems, and helping teams turn rough ideas into usable interfaces.
The work spans research, prototyping, design systems, accessibility, and close collaboration with engineering teams.

homeExperience.summary: Led product design for internal tools, customer dashboards, and reusable interface patterns across a growing software platform.
Designed responsive marketing and product experiences for small business, education, and operations teams.
Helped early-stage teams clarify product flows, improve usability, and create lightweight design systems.

resumeExperience.summary: Owned design work for a complex SaaS platform, including research, journey mapping, prototypes, design system improvements, accessibility reviews, and handoff with engineering.
Created responsive web experiences and product flows for client teams, balancing brand needs, usability goals, content strategy, and implementation constraints.
Managed support workflows, documented recurring issues, helped improve internal tooling, and partnered with product teams on customer pain points.

projects: Workflow audit: mapped a complex internal approval process and reduced duplicate steps across several teams.
Component library: built documentation and usage guidance for shared interface components.
Prototype sprint: helped a small team validate a new dashboard concept before engineering investment.
